name: Ninh Binh provincial data center
developer: Ninh Binh provincial authorities / Department of Science and Technology with provincial IT & Communication Center
notes: Official Ninh Binh newspaper and provincial science-technology portal reference the operating provincial data center that hosts more than 20 essential shared information systems; the 2024 digital-transformation plan invests in expanding its server/storage capacity. Public-sector scale, no MW disclosed.

name: Thai Binh provincial data center
developer: Thai Binh provincial authorities / Department of Information and Communications
notes: VietnamNet (sourced from Bao Thai Binh) reports Thai Binh's shared digital platforms run on centralized data stored at the provincial data center, including the LGSP integration platform, open-data portal (data.thaibinh.gov.vn) and smart-traffic camera feeds; DoITT plans to upgrade the shared platform infrastructure. No MW disclosed.

name: Thanh Hoa IT building / provincial data center project
notes: VietnamNet reports the 334 billion VND, 12-storey Thanh Hoa IT building (started Sep 2019, >90% complete by Feb 2021) is designated to house the provincial data center, network/cybersecurity center and smart-city operations center (IOC); a 2023 plan further targets data-center and cloud infrastructure for 2023-2025. No MW disclosed.

name: SK Group AI data center (Nghe An)
developer: SK Group (SK Innovation) with National Innovation Center (NIC) and Nghe An provincial authorities
notes: Tuoi Tre reports SK Group signed MOUs with Nghe An province and NIC to develop an AI data center in Nghe An, linked to the Quynh Lap LNG power project (1.5GW) for which SK Innovation is studying power/energy solutions. Early-stage MOU, capacity not disclosed.

name: Nghe An data infrastructure and smart-city program
notes: VJST reports a 6 Apr 2025 provincial UBND meeting on current data assets and smart-city direction, signaling expansion of Nghe An's data infrastructure. Policy-level item rather than a named facility; no MW disclosed.

name: Nebula Energy / PV GAS Vung Ang data center (proposed)
notes: Nebula Energy and PV GAS signed cooperation to study a ~1 billion USD data center investment at Vung Ang Economic Zone, Ha Tinh, per the province's information portal as reported by trade press. Early-stage proposal/MoU; capacity not disclosed.

name: Quang Binh provincial electronic data center
developer: Quang Binh provincial authorities / Department of Information and Communications
notes: Industry source (Smartpro) describes a 7-day information-security platform upgrade for shared databases and systems operated at the Quang Binh provincial electronic data center; source publication date not shown, checked 2026-08-11. Public-sector scale; no MW disclosed.

name: Global HP Digital Connection data center, Quan Ngang Industrial Park
developer: Toan Cau HP Digital Connection JSC
notes: Quang Tri PPC on 27 Dec 2024 discussed a 200 million USD (about 4,800 billion VND) data center proposal by Toan Cau HP Digital Connection JSC at the TRLC factory area in Quan Ngang IP, Gio Linh district. Proposed by a company registered only weeks earlier; project on the province's investment-attraction list. No MW disclosed.

name: Thua Thien-Hue electronic data center
developer: Thua Thien-Hue provincial authorities / Department of Information and Communications
notes: VietnamNet reports the provincial electronic data center was launched on 30 May 2011 at 36 Pham Van Dong, Hue city; approved investment over 4.3 billion VND, 3-storey building of 247 m2, construction from Mar 2010; manages the province's shared GIS and e-government databases. No MW disclosed.

name: Vietsoftpro Holdings digital data center project
notes: Real-estate/news aggregator lists a 'Trung tam Du lieu so' (digital data center) project by Vietsoftpro Holdings JSC with registered capital of 279.48 billion VND among 11 projects issued investment registration certificates in Thua Thien-Hue; exact certificate date not shown, checked 2026-08-11. Secondary source; capacity not disclosed.

name: Quang Nam provincial integrated data center
developer: Quang Nam provincial authorities / Department of Information and Communications
notes: Bao Phap Luat reports the Quang Nam integrated data center (about 249 billion VND, including main DC, SOC and SD-WAN network) was inaugurated and put into use on 9 Oct 2023 at floor 6 of the provincial archive center, Tam Ky; part of the 2021-2025 e-government/digital-government project. No MW disclosed.
